description: This file defines a PHP class 'Vtiger_PDF_InventoryHeaderViewer' that extends the 'Vtiger_PDF_HeaderViewer' class, responsible for rendering inventory headers in PDF documents for the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods to calculate total header height and to display the inventory header with company logo, title, and other details on the PDF.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_InventoryHeaderViewer
classes.description: A class for rendering the inventory header section in a PDF document, including logo, title, and other header information.

methods.name: totalHeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total height of the header section, returning a fixed height unless it's the first page.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the inventory header onto the PDF, including logo, summary, content, custom fields, and title, with formatting.
